reason: Fix autoreview P2 on the sibling-worktree resolution: it takes the FIRST parent carrying .git and only then checks whether that parent is a harness worktree, so a nested Git root on the way up — a vendored dependency, a sub-project, any checkout inside the tree — makes it give up and fall back to session-cwd governance, which is the ungoverned-write hole the fix exists to close. Keep walking outward instead, to the first parent that has BOTH .git and factory/scripts. One predicate rather than find-then-validate, and shorter than what it replaces. Adds a nested-root case to the governance test.
